description: This Java class defines an Android Activity called SenderActivity that allows a user to input a message and send it to another activity (ReceiverActivity) when a button is clicked.

classes.name: SenderActivity
classes.description: An Android activity for sending user input messages to another component within the app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and sets up the button click listener to send a message.
